_note: Performance rating (garage/rating.js): 100–999 from quick estimates of acceleration (0–100 km/h), top speed, cornering grip and braking. weights: each estimate's share of the rating; ranges: the estimate that scores nothing and the one that scores full marks. classes: the rating each class starts at, lowest first. (Phase 5: C from 460, B 580, A 680, S 740 — so a hot hatch is C, a muscle car or a rally saloon B and a supercar S, as the cars are, and a class-D car fully upgraded is B at most; the starter car stays D.)
